nytaxi:textmessage_welcome: NY Taxi at your service! Need a ride? Call us any time you're out on the street and we'll send the nearest cab your way.
nytaxi:dialog_refuse_indoors: Sorry, we can't pick you up from inside a building. Step out to the street and call us again!
nytaxi:dialog_offer: NY Taxi, good day! Need a cab? A car can be at your location within 5-10 minutes.
nytaxi:message_player_order: I need a taxi at my location, please.
nytaxi:message_dispatcher_confirm: Cab's on the way! It will reach you in about {minutes} minutes. Once it arrives, tell the driver where you're headed.
